sheets.name: Instructions
rows: Review independently before seeing scorer output or another reviewer's decisions.
Enter eligible, excluded, or pending under the approved eligibility policy.
For eligible cases, enter each W as 0 or 1 under the approved rubric; leave all Ws blank for excluded or pending eligibility.
Enter yes or no. Preserve uncertainty in the single note; do not turn missing information into an invented fact.
At most one narrative rationale/uncertainty sentence per case; retain the original indication and review case ID.
Leave unanswered review fields blank. Missing answers remain pending; they are never converted to zero.
Return this workbook only through the approved research environment. Reviewer identity and blinding attestations are recorded separately.
